sources.title: Original GLM-5V-Turbo release announcement
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened complete April 1 launch. It describes a new CogViT vision encoder, multimodal-compatible MTP and vision/text integration from pretraining. The smaller-model-size phrase gives no number or explicit comparator. No production total or active count is published.

sources.title: Original international GLM-5V-Turbo launch post
sources.evidence: Native X syndication confirms Zai_org author, model introduction and timestamp 2026-04-01T15:55:41Z. The long post is truncated in native syndication; its API/chat suffix is independently corroborated by the complete corporate release in s1, so no mirrored suffix is required as sole release evidence.

sources.title: GLM-5V-Turbo technical report
sources.publisher: GLM-5V-Turbo Team, Z.ai and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: Freshly read original report, especially sections 1 and 2.1-2.3, and searched the complete text. Section 1 explicitly names GLM-5-Turbo as its language-only base. The target adds CogViT and an MLP adapter and adopts MMTP using a shared learnable image token. The 0.5B number in section 2.2 is explicitly an ablation model. No production total, active count or countable component dimensions are published; previous Figure 2 inspection establishes Transformer blocks and shared MTP modules.

sources.title: GLM-5V-Turbo native API guide
sources.evidence: Reopened native page and complete Markdown. It describes CogViT, multimodal MTP and smaller model size without giving a numeric total/active count or scoped language-backbone subtotal. Retains documented video/image/text/file input, text output, 200K context, 128K output, thinking and function calling.

sources.title: Exact GLM-5V-Turbo Z.AI route metadata
sources.evidence: Direct JSON identifies the Z.AI route z-ai/glm-5v-turbo-20260401, context_length 202752 and max_completion_tokens 131072. Modalities are text/image/video to text; reasoning and tools are supported. This is a documented native-provider route, not a live inference test or checkpoint configuration.

sources.title: BigModel release log
sources.evidence: The April 2, 2026 entry announces GLM-5V-Turbo and its native guide. This later date label does not override the April 1 corporate announcement and original public international post.

sources.title: Z.ai hosted API terms
sources.evidence: Model parameters, algorithms, code and framework ownership remain with Z.ai; API access grants limited service-use rights. Supports proprietary as a classification of hosted service terms, without asserting that a separately released checkpoint could not have another license.

sources.title: Official public checkpoint inventory
sources.evidence: Accessed full returned inventory; no exact GLM-5V-Turbo repository was present. This corroborates the hosted distribution documented at launch, but absence alone does not prove that no checkpoint or alias exists anywhere.

sources.title: Official GLM-V release history and downloads
sources.evidence: Names the April 2 GLM-5V-Turbo release with an API-guide link; its open checkpoint table contains other GLM-V models. The August 26 entry describes GLM-5.3-Flash as the first open-source natively multimodal model. No exact 5V-Turbo checkpoint mapping or parameter count is supplied.

sources.title: Later GLM-5.3-Flash original card
sources.evidence: Fresh complete later card inspected. Its 320B total/18B active identifies GLM-5.3-Flash, which explicitly starts from a newly trained base with hybrid sparse/linear attention and mHC. No GLM-5V-Turbo checkpoint or count mapping appears; these numbers cannot be transferred backwards.

sources.title: Later GLM-5.3 original card
sources.evidence: Fresh complete later card and comparison table inspected. It explicitly shares the GLM-5.2 base and describes posttraining gains, but does not name GLM-5V-Turbo or provide a count mapping for it.

sources.title: Later GLM-5.2 original card
sources.evidence: Checked the full later card and comparisons for exact GLM-5V-Turbo specifications. No exact-model count or architecture mapping appears; GLM-5.2 specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Revised GLM-V technical report
sources.publisher: GLM-V Team, Zhipu AI and Tsinghua University
sources.evidence: Checked this later revision of the original vision-model report; it discusses GLM-4.6V and earlier GLM-V models but does not name GLM-5V-Turbo or disclose its production counts or routing.

sources.title: Original GLM-5 family comparison and download table
sources.evidence: Checked exact labeled download/count rows and full README. GLM-5V-Turbo is not listed or mapped; 744B/40B rows for other GLM-5 releases cannot establish its size.

sources.title: P3D-Bench original evaluation, Table 2
sources.publisher: P3D-Bench authors, Nanjing University and Envision
sources.evidence: Table 2 explicitly labels Size (total / active) and assigns GLM 5V Turbo a dash. Its caption defines this as an undisclosed count for closed-weight models. The separate GLM-5.1 754B/40B and Kimi/MiMo rows do not supply target counts.

sources.title: Original GLM-5 model card
sources.evidence: The base card directly publishes 744B parameters and 40B active. These are GLM-5 values, not an exact-model GLM-5V-Turbo disclosure; the structural and counting-scope checks in s3/s17 prevent direct transfer.

sources.title: GLM-5 technical report, Appendix A Table 10
sources.evidence: Read original Appendix A Table 10 and caption: GLM-5 has nominal 744B total and 40B activated, including MTP layers but excluding word embeddings and output. This convention is not a bare language-backbone subtotal with MTP removed; the multimodal target changes MTP and adds vision components.

sources.title: Original GLM-5-Turbo named-variant launch
sources.evidence: Fresh X-owned syndication returns Zai_org, March 15 timestamp and the original launch explicitly describing Turbo as a high-speed variant of GLM-5. Together with s3 this establishes a named two-step lineage, but does not erase the subsequent target-specific modality/structural additions.

sources.title: Current official GLM-V release history and downloads
sources.evidence: Fresh current README names GLM-5V-Turbo in the April 2 update and links its API guide. The download table contains GLM-4.6V, GLM-4.5V and GLM-4.1V models; no exact target checkpoint mapping or numerical production size appears.

name.note: Exact original vision-model name, distinct from the language-only GLM-5-Turbo base and later GLM-5.3-Flash.

developer.note: Original release identifies Z.ai/Zhipu AI; the technical report lists the GLM-5V-Turbo team at Z.ai and Tsinghua University.

family.note: Member of the GLM vision-language series; the family key does not imply identical weights or routing to another GLM release.

release_date.note: Original corporate announcement explicitly dates public API/chat availability April 1; native X confirms the same UTC day. BigModel and GLM-V repository use April 2. The separately limited Coding Plan trial is not the only release channel.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted API/chat. No exact public checkpoint or explicit alias mapping was verified in the accessed original inventories. Clear baseline false rather than treating absence as conclusive proof of closed weights; do not inherit the language base’s distribution status.

license.note: Describes the documented hosted API terms. No exact weight license was found; MIT on other GLM checkpoints is not transferred.

parameters_b.note: Fresh originals and later P3D-Bench Table 2 disclose no production total. The report explicitly names GLM-5-Turbo as the language-only base, itself a named GLM-5 variant, but the target adds CogViT/MLP and multimodal MTP. GLM-5 nominal 744B includes its MTP, so it is neither a complete target count nor an isolated unchanged backbone subtotal. The 0.5B ablation and later Flash 320B do not describe this release.

active_parameters_b.note: Separate active-count searches and later original comparison review found no numerical target convention; P3D-Bench explicitly leaves total/active size undisclosed. The named GLM-5 lineage is real, but its 40B convention includes MTP and cannot establish the multimodal target active count after new vision components and MMTP. No runtime-phase or backbone-only count is published; do not copy Flash 18B or equate active with total.

architecture.note: Original Figure 2 explicitly shows CogViT plus MLP adapter and text embeddings feeding Transformer blocks, followed by shared-parameter multimodal MTP modules. The report establishes the Transformer architecture but not dense/MoE routing, expert counts or precise attention design.

context_window.note: Native guide advertises rounded 200K; exact native-provider route specifies 202752. This is the served route limit, not an unpublished checkpoint capacity. Maximum output 131072 is separate.

modalities.note: Native modalities are text/image/video to text. File/PDF is a container for visual/text content, not a separate native modality. Tool-created imagery and Skills backed by GLM-Image do not establish native image generation.

reasoning.note: Native guide and exact provider route support thinking; API examples enable or disable it.

tool_call.note: Original release and report document multimodal tool use; native guide and exact route support function calls.

description.value: Vision-language Transformer with CogViT, multimodal token prediction, reasoning and tool calling.
description.note: Describes verified model components and capabilities without unsupported speed or quality comparisons.

patch.description: Vision-language Transformer with CogViT, multimodal token prediction, reasoning and tool calling.
patch.notes: Released April 1, 2026 via native API and chat; BigModel and the GLM-V repository use April 2. Production total/active counts remain undisclosed. The report names GLM-5-Turbo as its language-only base but adds CogViT/MLP and multimodal MTP; the base family's 744B/40B cannot establish this model's counts. Its 0.5B ablation is not the released model. Exact open-weight status is unverified; proprietary describes hosted API terms. Native-provider context is 202752 tokens, advertised as 200K, with a separate 131072 output cap. Files contain text and visual inputs; output is text.

summary: Preserved the other twelve field assessments, including April 1 public release, Transformer architecture with CogViT/MLP/MMTP, proprietary hosted terms, native served context 202752 and unverified exact open-weight status. October 27 parameter re-audit separately rechecked total and active counts, the original report and launch, named GLM-5-Turbo/GLM-5 lineage, later GLM cards and P3D-Bench Table 2. Both counts remain undisclosed: new vision components and MMTP prevent direct transfer of the base family's MTP-inclusive 744B/40B convention, and no countable scoped subtotal is supplied. The 0.5B ablation is not the released model.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=null and active_parameters_b=null, both undisclosed, after fresh separate review.

fresh_originals.finding: Read complete launch: new CogViT, multimodal MTP, vision/text pretraining and unnumbered smaller-size phrase.
Read original sections 1 and 2.1-2.3 and searched all text: explicit language-only GLM-5-Turbo base, new CogViT/MMTP, 0.5B ablation only.
Read current complete native guide and its launch/architecture section; no numerical count.
Read Table 2 header, caption and exact target row: Size (total / active) is a dash explicitly meaning undisclosed.
Read exact GLM-5 introduction: 744B total / 40B active.
Read complete later card: 320B/18B applies to newly trained GLM-5.3-Flash, not target.
Read complete later card and comparison table: no target count/mapping.
Read release history and download table: target API announcement, no exact checkpoint count.
Read Appendix A Table 10: 744B/40B includes MTP but excludes embeddings/output.
Read original-account syndication payload: high-speed variant of GLM-5.

parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: No exact-model nominal production total recovered. The 0.5B number is explicitly an MMTP ablation. P3D-Bench Table 2 later leaves exact target size undisclosed. The source-backed lineage is considered rather than dismissed as family resemblance, but added vision components and MMTP defeat whole-model count transfer. No published sized component or isolated unchanged subtotal can be substituted.
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: No exact target active count or original comparison-team numerical convention recovered. P3D-Bench labels total/active and explicitly marks the target undisclosed. The GLM-5 nominal 40B convention includes MTP; target MMTP and native vision additions leave the target scope unresolved. No active=total assumption or invented prefill/decode split is used.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: GLM-5V-Turbo section 1 explicitly names GLM-5-Turbo as its language-only base; the original Turbo launch explicitly calls Turbo a GLM-5 variant. Unlike pure posttraining, GLM-5V-Turbo introduces CogViT, MLP visual adaptation and multimodal MTP with a learnable image token, with visual/text integration from pretraining. The base 744B/40B count convention already includes MTP, so it is not a directly reusable isolated language-transformer subtotal. The launch smaller-size phrase alone does not prove the text backbone was pruned or numerically smaller; the decision rests on the documented additions and unresolved component/count convention.
parameter_reaudit.search_findings: Fresh total, active, Chinese, lineage and later-paper searches surfaced primary launch/guide sources and secondary catalogs/articles. Some secondary snippets repeat 744B/40B, one inconsistently gives 744/745B and 44B, while others say unknown. These are leads rather than original specifications; direct developer sources and later original comparison do not corroborate them for the exact multimodal target. Later GLM-5.3-Flash explicitly starts from a new base and cannot supply target counts.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: All ten HTTP fetches in the local manifest succeeded. The web extractor initially timed out on the Chinese release, subsequently retrieved in full by direct HTTP and fresh primary-domain search. No weight shards were requested. The later-card text and tables were reviewed for exact target names; unrelated performance graphics were not used as parameter evidence.
parameter_reaudit.remaining_uncertainty: Both production counts and countable component subtotals remain unpublished in the checked material. This bounded fresh review does not prove that no disclosure exists anywhere.
